hooks.name: Check feature on save
hooks.description: After a TypeScript file in src is saved, lint and test the feature that changed, staying inside the owner's folder.

action.prompt: A source file in src/ was just saved. Run `npm run lint` and the Vitest tests for the feature folder that changed (for example `npx vitest run src/features/<name>`). If something fails, fix it only inside the current owner's folder (src/features/<name>/). Never edit src/core, src/app, package.json or another feature's folder. If the fix needs a core or dependency change, tell the user to message Jolo instead.
